item.description:

Maple-Sausage Breakfast Casserole: 1-hour prep, 12 servings. Mix flour, sugar, baking powder, pepper, salt; cook sausage, drain fat, mix with eggs and milk. Combine with flour mixture, add sausage and cheese. Bake, top with maple butter. Serve warm.

item.title: How We Brought a Taste of Maine to Bon Appétit LIVE
item.description:
【AI 精简版】 AI-condensed version. This text was produced by an LLM from the original article and may omit details. The original link at the end is the only authoritative source.

Attendees at Bon Appétit LIVE experienced Maine flavors with a lobster cooking class and wild blueberry shortcake demo. Carly Westerfield and Krista Tripp taught lobster preparation and oyster tasting. Tripp's oysters mature in the Lower Weskeag River, filtering water and contributing to a healthier ecosystem. Jesse Szewczyk prepared shortcakes with wild Maine blueberries from Brodis Blueberries. Ron Howard discussed challenges and innovations in blueberry farming. Carolann Ouellette highlighted Maine's diverse food culture and sustainability focus.

Source: Bon Appétit | Published: 2026-11-18 21:45 UTC

Original link: https://www.bonappetit.com/story/bon-appetit-live-2026-visit-maine-recap
